summary: Scholar Rock Holding Corp filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting via Items 7.01 and 8.01 that the FDA approved ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) on September 11, 2026, for SMA in adults and children 2 years and older receiving SMN2-targeted treatment. The approval marks the first muscle-targeted SMA therapy; the recommended 10 mg/kg dose showed a 2.2-point Hammersmith Functional Motor Scale-Expanded improvement. The company furnished a press release and presentation slides and hosted a webcast. This is a routine product-approval current report, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated.
